integrity: The universal statements are proved analytically. Exact symbolic and rational computations replay the displayed formulas and witnesses. The 1975 paper was inspected in full text for the MINRES formulation and nearby properties; the search did not locate an implication-equivalent componentwise theorem. Search incompleteness remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The exact threshold is for the specified diagonal spectrum and right-hand-side family. The minimality statement is restricted to exact-arithmetic, unpreconditioned MINRES from zero on SPD Stieltjes systems with nonnegative right-hand sides. No claim is made for all three-dimensional Stieltjes systems, finite precision, nonzero starts, or preconditioned/constrained variants.
title: A sharp three-mode positivity threshold for MINRES on a diagonal Stieltjes system
